# BILL

> BILL is a financial operations platform enabling businesses and accounting firms to automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense management, and cash flow operations.

BILL provides comprehensive financial automation solutions for small-to-mid-sized businesses and professional service firms. The platform integrates AI-powered invoice processing, payment automation, and compliance features across multiple payment methods including ACH, card disbursements, and the BILL Divvy Card.

## Key Topics

- Accounts Payable (AP)
- Accounts Receivable (AR)
- Financial Operations
- Expense Management
- Cash Flow Management
- Spend Management
- AI and Machine Learning
- Compliance and Security
- Payment Automation
- Fraud Prevention
- Digital Payments
- BILL Divvy Card
- API Integration
- SMB Empowerment
- Healthcare Solutions

## Platform & Core Solutions

- [BILL | Financial Operations Platform for Businesses & Firms](https://www.bill.com): BILL financial operations platform for AP, AR, and expense management
- [Bill For Healthcare Organizations](https://www.bill.com/solutions/healthcare): BILL solutions for healthcare with HIPAA compliance and ePHI protection
